text_block_list.text: I was explaining the training routine to Air Groove, but she didn't seem to be feeling well at all...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing... pay it no mind.
Continue your explanation."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Aargh, I told you I'm fine, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. How careless of me...
I've had a terrible headache lately.
Air Groove seems to be suffering from a headache...
